request.prompt: Create Lanternwater Lanes, a fictional storybook canal village on a flat 180 metre square. Retain the idea of a copper-domed archive, workshops, cottages, market courts, orchard planting and a canal, but make a denser settlement that feels grown over time. Use 45–60 objects, including about 24–30 varied buildings arranged into three close clusters along a gently bending market lane and a short waterfront spine. Aim for about 25–35% summed building footprint coverage, with varied narrow gaps and occasional shared walls, while keeping useful routes clear. Include two small uneven gathering courts rather than a giant central square. Orient buildings to their nearby route and cluster; avoid identical rows, equal setbacks and right-angle symmetry. Let the canal or shore have a simple bent polygon outline. Place only a few useful trees and fixtures in leftover pockets. Keep all footprints inside the scene and avoid solid overlaps. Use original bounded geometry for the copper-domed archive and one workshop, with other roofs interpreted from authored facts. Reference real layout relationships creatively; this is fiction, not a copy of a real town.

World coordinates are x=east, y=north in METRES from the southwest corner. Placements are centres; width is local east–west, depth local north–south before rotation, height vertical. Parent links are semantic; child positions remain absolute world coordinates, with no inherited transform.

USER_BRIEF="Create Lanternwater Lanes, a fictional storybook canal village on a flat 180 metre square. Retain the idea of a copper-domed archive, workshops, cottages, market courts, orchard planting and a canal, but make a denser settlement that feels grown over time. Use 45–60 objects, including about 24–30 varied buildings arranged into three close clusters along a gently bending market lane and a short waterfront spine. Aim for about 25–35% summed building footprint coverage, with varied narrow gaps and occasional shared walls, while keeping useful routes clear. Include two small uneven gathering courts rather than a giant central square. Orient buildings to their nearby route and cluster; avoid identical rows, equal setbacks and right-angle symmetry. Let the canal or shore have a simple bent polygon outline. Place only a few useful trees and fixtures in leftover pockets. Keep all footprints inside the scene and avoid solid overlaps. Use original bounded geometry for the copper-domed archive and one workshop, with other roofs interpreted from authored facts. Reference real layout relationships creatively; this is fiction, not a copy of a real town."

proposal.summary: Lanternwater Lanes is a compact canal village of close workshop, cottage and archive clusters. A bending market lane links two uneven courts, short neighborhood passages and a working waterfront, with orchard pockets tucked behind the buildings.
proposal.name: Lanternwater Lanes
proposal.description: An original storybook settlement on flat ground. Ochre cottages line the older southern lane; a skewed western workshop quarter gathers around an orchard court; and a copper-domed archive anchors the northern bend beside the canal. Rooflines, building depths and narrow passages vary between these locally aligned groups.

additions.label: Village ground
additions.description: A continuous quiet green base beneath the village and its garden pockets.

additions.label: Lanternwater Canal
additions.description: A simple bent canal edge bounds the village to the east, widening opposite the working quay.

additions.label: Old Market Lane
additions.description: The broadest old lane runs between cottage shops and their opposing frontages.

additions.label: Coppersmith Bend
additions.description: A narrow diagonal continuation turns between the southern houses and western workshops.

additions.label: Archive Approach
additions.description: The lane changes direction again, threading past the western quarter toward the northern court.

additions.label: Lantern Bend
additions.description: A shallow final bend opens toward the archive forecourt and waterfront.

additions.label: Short Lantern Quay
additions.description: A short waterside spine joins the southern market, quay workshops and northern bend.

additions.label: Basket Passage
additions.description: An unobstructed continuation carries the old lane onto the quay.

additions.label: Crooked Apron Lane
additions.description: A gently angled neighborhood lane gives the western workshops their shared frontage.

additions.label: Orchard Passage
additions.description: A narrow passage between workshop pairs opens into the rear orchard court.

additions.label: Netmakers Passage
additions.description: A short transverse passage connects the main bend to the quay between the two eastern building pairs.

additions.label: Archive Threshold
additions.description: A broad threshold connects the archive court to the final lane bend.

additions.label: Pearwright Court
additions.description: An uneven, intimate gathering court occupies the gap between two workshop ranges, with orchard trees at its quiet ends.

additions.label: Copperleaf Court
additions.description: A small tapered market court sits immediately before the archive and neighboring northern houses.

additions.label: Embercrust Bakery
additions.description: A deep bakery presents a modest shopfront to the old lane.

additions.label: Waxwick House
additions.description: A narrow candle shop with a dwelling above stands close beside the bakery.

additions.label: Ribbonkeeper House
additions.description: A broad ribbon seller's house has a slightly shallower rear yard edge.

additions.label: The Drowsy Lantern
additions.description: A taller inn anchors the lane bend without occupying its turning space.

additions.label: Reedbasket Provisions
additions.description: A deep provisions shop serves the market and quay.

additions.label: Ferryman's House
additions.description: A sturdy end house marks the approach to Basket Passage.

additions.label: Patchwindow Cottage
additions.description: A mender's cottage faces the bakery across the old lane.

additions.label: Sageglass House
additions.description: An herbalist's broad house closes the western frontage before the diagonal passage.

additions.label: Folded Sail Rooms
additions.description: A low sailmaker's range faces south, leaving a clear gap beside the bending lane.

additions.label: Blue Door Store
additions.description: A broad storage house completes the lane's eastern north frontage.

additions.label: Pearglaze Pottery
additions.description: A squat pottery turns with Crooked Apron Lane rather than the older southern frontage.

additions.label: Threadspine Bindery
additions.description: A compact bindery faces the angled workshop lane.

additions.label: Little Keyworks
additions.description: A narrower locksmith's shop leaves the turning passage open at the cluster's eastern tip.

additions.label: Threefold Copperworks
additions.description: An original three-bay workshop has stepped copper roof caps above a brick working hall, facing the angled lane.

additions.label: Rainthread Weaving House
additions.description: A deep weaving house shares the workshop frontage and backs onto Pearwright Court.

additions.label: Pearleaf Press
additions.description: A shallow printshop terminates the workshop range beside Orchard Passage.

additions.label: Russet Pear Cottage
additions.description: A substantial orchard household faces the rear court across a narrow shared apron.

additions.label: Pipkeeper House
additions.description: A deeper family house forms the middle of the orchard court's northern edge.

additions.label: Green Shutter Cottage
additions.description: A smaller end cottage leaves an opening beside the passage back to the market lane.

additions.label: Silvermesh Workshop
additions.description: An angled netmaker's range presents its long side toward the quay quarter.

additions.label: Willow Rib Boatworks
additions.description: A neighboring boatwright's hall has a slightly lower roof and a clear apron toward the waterfront.

additions.label: Blue Compass House
additions.description: A chartmaker's tall house faces the passage between the paired waterfront ranges.

additions.label: Moonwake Guesthouse
additions.description: An angled guesthouse completes the small quay group without blocking its cross-passage.

additions.label: Copperleaf Archive
additions.description: A square masonry archive crowned by a broad copper dome overlooks the northern market court. Its authored geometry is an original storybook interpretation.

additions.label: Keeper's House
additions.description: The archive keeper's house shares a wall with the smaller lantern guild house.

additions.label: Lantern Guild House
additions.description: A narrow guild house adjoins the keeper's house and closes the court near the canal.

additions.label: Old Court Pear
additions.description: A trained pear occupies the western pocket beside the orchard court, away from its walking strip.

additions.label: Passage Pear
additions.description: A second pear tree sits beyond the orchard passage in an unbuilt garden pocket.

additions.label: Little Russet Apple
additions.description: An apple tree shades the open pocket south of the western lane entrance.

additions.label: Pearwright Bench
additions.description: A short bench rests at the court edge, outside the through passage.

additions.label: Copperleaf Lantern
additions.description: A single tall lantern marks the court's canal-side edge without occupying its market passage.

additions.label: Boatwright Mooring
additions.description: A small mooring post stands on the waterward margin of the quay.
